title: Austin Development & Transit Plans
summary:
*   The Urban Transportation Commission reported on its transportation goals and achievements.
*   Staff briefed on a new performance-based model for economic development projects.
*   Council discussed "The Domain," a major proposed development project, as part of the new economic strategy.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORK SESSION
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 23, 2003
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they occurred
during the meeting.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, April 23,
2003 at One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, 3rd Floor Training Room, Austin,
Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:01 a.m.
PREVIEW OF ITEMS FOR NEXT WORKSESSION
BRIEFINGS
1. Report by the Urban Transportation Commission on its goals and accomplishments.
The presentation was made by Michelle Brinkman, Commissioner.
2. Staff briefing on Economic Development projects using the new Economic Development Model
of performance based investments and discussion of proposal for The Domain.
The presentation was made by City Manager Toby Hammett Futrell; Sue Edwards, Director
of Redevelopment Services; Lisa Gordon, Assistant City Manager; and David Lloyd,
Attorney Senior.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 11:15 p.m. was approved on Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman's motion, Council Member Wynn's second on a 7-0 vote.
The minutes for the work session of April 23, 2003 were approved on May 8, 2003 on
Council Member Slusher's motion, Council Member Thomas' second on a 7-0 vote.
